Title: Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB supports PostgreSQL 18

Body.Content:
Azure HorizonDB is a fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible, cloud-native database service designed for scalable, high-performance workloads.

Azure HorizonDB, now in public preview, includes PostgreSQL 18 support.

Learn more.
